comments.author: @OS_Documentaries
comments.text:
Hello, everyone.
In this video, we filmed how the people of Yakutia, who live in the Siberian region of Russia, are preparing for the coming harsh winter.
We presented a glimpse into an elderly family’s struggle for survival.
If you like the video, please share it on your social media accounts and subscribe to the channel so we can create more content like this. Enjoy the video : )

comments.author: @melisa4358-j5j
comments.text: They are living under extremely difficult conditions—conditions far harsher than the circumstances we often complain about, despite the many blessings we have. Yet, the video clearly captures the sense of peace in their lives; they are such cheerful and hospitable people. Also, well done on your hard work—this is another wonderful video. It made me so happy to see you pay off the grocery store debts for these individuals, who, despite their advanced age, have to struggle so hard just to meet their basic needs. 👏🏼
